Post-episode Reflexion (not sent to GM):
New plan: I failed because I incorrectly assumed the nesting order of the remaining open brackets. In the input `< { < ( )`, the stack of open brackets from bottom to top is `<`, `{`, `<`. The `(` was opened and immediately closed by `)`, so it is not on the stack. To close the sequence properly, I must pop the stack in reverse order: first close the innermost `<` with `>`, then the `{` with `}`, and finally the outermost `<` with `>`. My previous output `) > } >` incorrectly included a closing parenthesis and reversed the order of the angle and curly braces. Next time, I will explicitly simulate a stack: push every opening bracket, pop and match every closing bracket, and then generate the remaining closing brackets in strict reverse order of the current stack contents. For this specific input, the correct completion is `> } >`.
